summary: A delegation receives an offer that names the individuals who could vote at large.
realLife: The Atlantic City proposal designated Aaron Henry and Edwin King for at-large votes while permitting the regular Mississippi delegates to sit if they signed the pledge.
gates: A compromise offers named seats outside the disputed state delegation.
inGame: needs: the seat type and recipient named in each term of the compromise.

turns.pulledBy: The committee lets the delegation choose the people instead.
turns.writesBack: The eventual names trace back to a delegation vote.

turns.what: The committee must decide whether the offer can transfer.
turns.writesBack: The unfilled place carries the terms of the original offer.
